messages:
Ada Patel: Quick heads up — I'm submitting my two-week notice. Last day will be May 9. Need a checklist for access cutover, laptop return, and mentor handoff.
Ravi Menon: Thanks for flagging, Ada. We'll start the offboard checklist. Can you confirm last working hour and whether you want an exit interview? @people-ops-bot will send the forms.
Ada Patel: Last day EOD PT on May 9. Yes to exit interview — prefer early morning. Also want to record a 30m knowledge transfer with Sam for the mentoring docs.
Sam Kim: I'm available next Tue/Wed for the KT. Can you dump a short runbook and the top 5 tickets I should watch?
Ada Patel: Will do. Runbook URL: https://notion.redwood/eng/ada-mentorship (I'll share full edits). Top tickets: #412, #487, #499.
Monica Chen: IT here — for device return we can either ship a prepaid label or you can drop at our SF office. Which do you prefer? Also note: we'll deprovision SSO and GSuite at 9:00am PT on May 10 (the business day after).
Ada Patel: Prepaid label works for me. Please also remove my SSH keys and API tokens on last day.
IT Ops: Confirmed. Deprovision plan: 
```
# run on deprovision window
revoke_tokens --user ada.patel && 
ssh-keygen -R github.com -f ~/.ssh/known_hosts || true
# revoke service account keys
revoke_service_keys --owner ada.patel
```
We'll revoke personal access tokens, remove org keys, and cut service account ownership transfers before 9am PT.
Ravi Menon: COBRA/benefits note — benefits will terminate end of day May 9; COBRA packet will be emailed within 7 business days. Final paycheck and any PTO payout will be processed in the regular payroll cycle; HR will confirm pro rata amount.
Ada Patel: Thanks — could you confirm last date for dependent coverage and any forms I need to sign for 401k rollover?
Ravi Menon: Dependent coverage ends 05/09 23:59 PT. We'll send 401k rollover vendor contact and the link to sign electronically.
people-ops-bot: Calendar event created: Exit interview with Ada Patel — May 10 09:00 PT (Ravi Menon). Link: https://calendar.redwood/evt/2509876543
Monica Chen: Shipping label sent to your personal email. Please wipe the device and leave company profile per instructions in the label packet. We'll collect serial on pickup.
Ada Patel: Got it. Added docs to the runbook and scheduled KT with Sam for Tue 10:00am. Leaving a short list of quick wins and who to ping for each. Thanks everyone. :wave:
